title: Flappy Pixel Wings
description: Tap or press Space to flap your wings and navigate between retro pipe obstacles. Test your precision and timing!
controls: Spacebar / Click / Tap - Flap Wings
Avoid green pipes and ground
Collect point for each pipe pair passed
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>body{margin:0;background:#0c1322;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;font-family:sans-serif;color:#fff}canvas{border:3px solid #38bdf8;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)}</style></head><body><canvas id='g' width='360' height='520'></canvas><script>const canvas=document.getElementById('g'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let bird={x:50,y:200,v:0,g:0.4,j:-7},pipes=[],frame=0,score=0,high=0,gameover=false;function reset(){bird.y=200;bird.v=0;pipes=[];score=0;gameover=false;}function loop(){ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.fillStyle='#15803d';ctx.fillRect(0,460,canvas.width,60);if(!gameover){bird.v+=bird.g;bird.y+=bird.v;if(frame%90===0){let gap=120,top=Math.random()*(250-80)+80;pipes.push({x:canvas.width,top,bot:top+gap});}pipes.forEach(p=>{p.x-=2;if(p.x+50<0){pipes.shift();score++;if(score>high)high=score;}if(bird.x+15>p.x&&bird.x-15<p.x+50&&(bird.y-15<p.top||bird.y+15>p.bot)){gameover=true;}});if(bird.y>445||bird.y<0)gameover=true;frame++;}pipes.forEach(p=>{ctx.fillStyle='#22c55e';ctx.fillRect(p.x,0,50,p.top);ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.bot,50,460-p.bot);});ctx.fillStyle='#facc15';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bird.x,bird.y,15,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bird.x+6,bird.y-4,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 32px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(score,canvas.width/2,60);if(gameover){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.font='bold 30px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',canvas.width/2,220);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='20px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('Score: '+score+'  High: '+high,canvas.width/2,260);ctx.font='16px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to Restart',canvas.width/2,310);}requestAnimationFrame(loop);}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='Space'||e.code==='KeyW'||e.code==='ArrowUp'){if(gameover)reset();else bird.v=bird.j;}});canvas.addEventListener('click', me => {if(gameover)reset();else bird.v=bird.j;});loop();</script></body></html>

title: Retro Cyber Pong
description: Challenge the AI in a fast-paced futuristic glowing table tennis battle! Smooth physics and adjustable difficulty.
controls: W / S or Up / Down Arrows - Control Player Paddle
Deflect the ball past AI paddle to score points
First to 7 points wins!
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>body{margin:0;background:#030712;color:#a855f7;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh}canvas{border:3px solid #c084fc;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(192,132,252,0.3)}</style></head><body><canvas id='p' width='600' height='400'></canvas><script>const canvas=document.getElementById('p'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let p1={x:20,y:160,w:12,h:80,s:0},p2={x:568,y:160,w:12,h:80,s:0},b={x:300,y:200,r:7,vx:5,vy:3};let keys={};function loop(){ctx.fillStyle='#030712';ctx.fillRect(0,0,600,400);ctx.strokeStyle='#374151';ctx.setLineDash([10,10]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(300,0);ctx.lineTo(300,400);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);if(keys['KeyW']||keys['ArrowUp'])p1.y=Math.max(0,p1.y-6);if(keys['KeyS']||keys['ArrowDown'])p1.y=Math.min(320,p1.y+6);let aiCenter=p2.y+40;if(aiCenter<b.y-10)p2.y+=4.5;else if(aiCenter>b.y+10)p2.y-=4.5;p2.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(320,p2.y));b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;if(b.y-b.r<0||b.y+b.r>400)b.vy*=-1;if(b.x-b.r<p1.x+p1.w&&b.y>p1.y&&b.y<p1.y+p1.h){b.vx=Math.abs(b.vx)*1.05;b.vy+=((b.y-(p1.y+40))/40)*2;}if(b.x+b.r>p2.x&&b.y>p2.y&&b.y<p2.y+p2.h){b.vx=-Math.abs(b.vx)*1.05;b.vy+=((b.y-(p2.y+40))/40)*2;}if(b.x<0){p2.s++;reset();}if(b.x>600){p1.s++;reset();}ctx.fillStyle='#c084fc';ctx.fillRect(p1.x,p1.y,p1.w,p1.h);ctx.fillStyle='#f43f5e';ctx.fillRect(p2.x,p2.y,p2.w,p2.h);ctx.fillStyle='#facc15';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.font='bold 36px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#c084fc';ctx.fillText(p1.s,230,50);ctx.fillStyle='#f43f5e';ctx.fillText(p2.s,340,50);requestAnimationFrame(loop);}function reset(){b={x:300,y:200,r:7,vx:(Math.random()>0.5?5:-5),vy:(Math.random()*4-2)};}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.code]=true);window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);loop();</script></body></html>

title: Neon Brick Breaker
description: Smash brightly colored glowing bricks with your energy sphere! Catch power-ups and clear every stage.
controls: Left / Right Arrow or Mouse - Move Paddle
Space / Click - Launch Ball
Clear all bricks to advance levels
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>body{margin:0;background:#090d16;color:#38bdf8;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh}canvas{border:3px solid #38bdf8;border-radius:12px;background:#030712;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(56,189,248,0.3)}</style></head><body><canvas id='b' width='500' height='400'></canvas><script>const canvas=document.getElementById('b'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let p={x:200,w:80,h:12},ball={x:250,y:350,r:7,vx:3,vy:-4,st:false},score=0,rows=4,cols=7,bricks=[];const colors=['#ef4444','#f97316','#eab308','#22c55e'];function initBricks(){bricks=[];for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){bricks.push({x:c*68+12,y:r*25+40,w:60,h:18,active:true,c:colors[r]});}}}initBricks();function loop(){ctx.fillStyle='#030712';ctx.fillRect(0,0,500,400);bricks.forEach(b=>{if(b.active){ctx.fillStyle=b.c;ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h);}});if(ball.st){ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.y+=ball.vy;if(ball.x-ball.r<0||ball.x+ball.r>500)ball.vx*=-1;if(ball.y-ball.r<0)ball.vy*=-1;if(ball.y+ball.r>380&&ball.x>p.x&&ball.x<p.x+p.w){ball.vy=-Math.abs(ball.vy);ball.vx+=((ball.x-(p.x+40))/40)*2;}if(ball.y>400){ball={x:p.x+40,y:370,r:7,vx:3,vy:-4,st:false};}bricks.forEach(b=>{if(b.active&&ball.x>b.x&&ball.x<b.x+b.w&&ball.y>b.y&&ball.y<b.y+b.h){b.active=false;ball.vy*=-1;score+=20;}});}else{ball.x=p.x+p.w/2;ball.y=375;}ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(p.x,380,p.w,p.h);ctx.fillStyle='#facc15';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 20px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('SCORE: '+score,20,30);requestAnimationFrame(loop);}window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{let rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();p.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(420,e.clientX-rect.left-40));});window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='ArrowLeft')p.x=Math.max(0,p.x-15);if(e.code==='ArrowRight')p.x=Math.min(420,p.x+15);if(e.code==='Space')ball.st=true;});canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>ball.st=true);loop();</script></body></html>

title: Galaxy Defender Classic
description: Defend Earth from marching waves of alien spacecraft! Dodge enemy laser bombardment and fire back.
controls: Left / Right Arrow - Move Cannon
Spacebar - Fire Plasma Missiles
Destroy all invaders before they descend!
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>body{margin:0;background:#030712;color:#a855f7;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh}canvas{border:3px solid #a855f7;border-radius:12px;background:#090d16}</style></head><body><canvas id='s' width='480' height='400'></canvas><script>const canvas=document.getElementById('s'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let p={x:220,w:30,h:15},bullets=[],aliens=[],score=0,dir=1;for(let r=0;r<3;r++){for(let c=0;c<8;c++){aliens.push({x:c*50+40,y:r*35+40,w:25,h:20,alive:true});}}function loop(){ctx.fillStyle='#090d16';ctx.fillRect(0,0,480,400);let edge=false;aliens.forEach(a=>{if(a.alive){a.x+=dir*1.5;if(a.x>440||a.x<10)edge=true;ctx.fillStyle='#22c55e';ctx.fillRect(a.x,a.y,a.w,a.h);}});if(edge){dir*=-1;aliens.forEach(a=>a.y+=10);}bullets.forEach((b,i)=>{b.y-=6;ctx.fillStyle='#facc15';ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,4,10);aliens.forEach(a=>{if(a.alive&&b.x>a.x&&b.x<a.x+a.w&&b.y>a.y&&b.y<a.y+a.h){a.alive=false;bullets.splice(i,1);score+=50;}});});bullets=bullets.filter(b=>b.y>0);ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(p.x,370,p.w,p.h);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 18px monospace';ctx.fillText('SCORE: '+score,20,30);requestAnimationFrame(loop);}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='ArrowLeft')p.x=Math.max(0,p.x-15);if(e.code==='ArrowRight')p.x=Math.min(450,p.x+15);if(e.code==='Space')bullets.push({x:p.x+13,y:360});});loop();</script></body></html>

title: Doodle Sky Jumper
description: Bounce endlessly upwards across moving spring platforms! Don't miss a ledge or fall into the abyss.
controls: Left / Right Arrow Keys or A / D - Tilt Jumper
Land on platforms to bounce automatically
Screen wraps around edges!
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>body{margin:0;background:#020617;color:#fbbf24;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh}canvas{border:3px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:12px;background:#0f172a}</style></head><body><canvas id='j' width='360' height='500'></canvas><script>const canvas=document.getElementById('j'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let p={x:160,y:400,vx:0,vy:-8},plat=[],score=0;for(let i=0;i<7;i++){plat.push({x:Math.random()*280,y:i*70+50,w:70,h:12});}function loop(){ctx.fillStyle='#0f172a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,360,500);p.vy+=0.3;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0)p.x=340;if(p.x>340)p.x=0;plat.forEach(pl=>{if(p.vy>0&&p.x+20>pl.x&&p.x<pl.x+pl.w&&p.y+30>pl.y&&p.y+30<pl.y+pl.h){p.vy=-9.5;}});if(p.y<200){let diff=200-p.y;p.y=200;score+=Math.floor(diff);plat.forEach(pl=>{pl.y+=diff;if(pl.y>500){pl.y=0;pl.x=Math.random()*280;}});};plat.forEach(pl=>{ctx.fillStyle='#22c55e';ctx.fillRect(pl.x,pl.y,pl.w,pl.h);});ctx.fillStyle='#fbbf24';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x+10,p.y+15,14,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 20px monospace';ctx.fillText('HEIGHT: '+score,20,30);if(p.y>520){p={x:160,y:400,vx:0,vy:-8};score=0;}requestAnimationFrame(loop);}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='ArrowLeft'||e.code==='KeyA')p.vx=-5;if(e.code==='ArrowRight'||e.code==='KeyD')p.vx=5;});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>p.vx=0);loop();</script></body></html>

title: Slope Physics Ball
description: Speed down a infinite steep slope in an intense 3D neon obstacle course! Avoid red blocks and falling off.
controls: A / D or Left / Right Arrow - Steer Ball Left / Right
Avoid red walls and gaps
Survive as long as possible for highest score
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><style>body{margin:0;background:#020617;color:#10b981;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh}canvas{border:3px solid #10b981;border-radius:12px;background:#000}</style></head><body><canvas id='sl' width='480' height='420'></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('sl'),ctx=c.getContext('2d');let ball={x:240,vx:0},score=0,speed=4,obs=[];function loop(){ctx.fillStyle='#020617';ctx.fillRect(0,0,480,420);ctx.strokeStyle='#1e293b';ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ctx.moveTo(0,i*40);ctx.lineTo(480,i*40);}ctx.stroke();if(Math.random()<0.08)obs.push({x:Math.random()*400,y:0,w:60,h:20});ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(460,ball.x));score++;obs.forEach(o=>{o.y+=speed;ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,o.h);if(o.y>350&&o.y<390&&ball.x>o.x&&ball.x<o.x+o.w){score=0;obs=[];}});ctx.fillStyle='#10b981';ctx.shadowBlur=15;ctx.shadowColor='#10b981';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,370,12,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 20px monospace';ctx.fillText('DISTANCE: '+score+'m',20,30);requestAnimationFrame(loop);}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='ArrowLeft'||e.code==='KeyA')ball.vx=-6;if(e.code==='ArrowRight'||e.code==='KeyD')ball.vx=6;});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>ball.vx=0);loop();</script></body></html>
